title: Notification settings
summary: The Notifications group of Settings (ADR 0112), for the account that is open (ADR 0138 rule 4: each account has its own notification settings): whether this phone gets notifications, what they are about for chats and groups, the message sound, whether the text shows, and, on a company account, the opening hours. Every row says its current value.

mode.description: all: every message. mentions: only when someone mentions you (groups only). off: no notifications.

phoneEnabled.description: The system permission is allowed and push-registration has a pusher.

chatsMode.description: Default for DMs: all or off (ADR 0141: no mentions mode in a DM).

groupsMode.description: Default for groups: all, mentions or off.

wholeGroupMentions.description: Notify when someone mentions the whole group (@room).

invites.description: Notify about chat requests and group invites.

sound.description: The message sound of this account on this phone. phone: the system default sound. soft: Bipe's soft sound. silent: no sound.

mentionsMayMiss.description: true when the homeserver cannot push encrypted events to the device, so mentions mode can miss messages.

hasOlderChoices.description: true when the push rules hold choices this screen does not show (keywords, older modes).

news.description: The switch bipe_settings_news with bipe_settings_news_body under it (ADR 0117, bipe-chat/bipe#387). on: GET /v1/me/news has subscribed true and Client.getRoom(room_id) is joined or invited. off: anything else. unknown: not read yet, or the API answered an error: the switch is hidden.

newsBusy.description: true while setNews runs: the switch is disabled.

preview.description: Per account on this phone: true shows the sender and the text; false shows bipe_app_name with bipe_app_notification_new_message only. Default true.

isCompany.description: account_type company in GET /v1/me/account: the row bipe_work_hours_title shows and opens work-hours, with its value bipe_work_hours_open_now or bipe_work_hours_closed_now when enabled.

appear.effect: Reads the system permission and the account push rules, fills the state, and refreshes when the rules change on another device.

enablePhone.effect: phoneEnabled false: asks the system permission when it was never asked, else opens the system settings of the app. On return, push-registration registers.

setChatsMode.effect: Sets the default mode for one-to-one rooms, encrypted and not.

setGroupsMode.effect: Sets the default mode for group rooms, encrypted and not. With hasOlderChoices, shows the older-choices dialog first.

setWholeGroupMentions.effect: Turns the room-mention push rule on or off.

setInvites.effect: Turns the invite-for-me push rule on or off.

setNews.effect: on: PUT /v1/me/news, then Client.joinRoomById(room_id) (the user's new or kept news room). off: Room.leave on the news room, then DELETE /v1/me/news. A failure puts the switch back and shows bipe_settings_news_failed.

setSound.effect: Saves the sound for this account on this phone. Android: moves this account's messages channel to that sound. A failure shows bipe_notifications_tone_error.

setPreview.effect: Saves preview for this account on this phone.

notes: Opens from settings-root, key notifications (registries/settings.json, screen element in the forks). settings-root shows bipe_settings_notifications_on or bipe_settings_notifications_off from phoneEnabled.

phoneEnabled false: a card at the top with bipe_settings_notifications_off, bipe_notifications_permission_body and the button bipe_notifications_enable. The rows below stay editable: they are account rules and apply on every device.

Mode map: all is RoomNotificationMode AllMessages, mentions is MentionsAndKeywordsOnly, off is Mute. getDefaultRoomNotificationMode takes isEncrypted and isOneToOne: the screen reads the encrypted value and writes both.
Chats offers all and off only (ADR 0141). A user who set mentions for DMs before keeps that server rule; the row then shows bipe_app_notification_mode_mentions until they change it.
mentionsMayMiss: under the groups row, bipe_group_screen_notification_settings_mentions_only_disclaimer, when canPushEncryptedEventToDevice is false.

hasOlderChoices: the encrypted and unencrypted defaults differ, or containsKeywordsRules is true. The first change shows bipe_notifications_mismatch_title and bipe_notifications_mismatch_body with bipe_action_continue and bipe_app_cancel.
Sound is a phone setting, not a push rule. bipe_notifications_tone_current is the accessibility value. Ringtones wait for calls (plan section 8: no calls at first).
A failed rule change puts the row back and shows bipe_error_generic.

Groups are quiet by default (ADR 0026, ADR 0053): a new account starts with groupsMode mentions and chatsMode all. The app sets these defaults once, at the first sign-in of an account that has no default rules of its own yet.

News (ADR 0117): the news account (@bipe, registries/official-accounts.json) keeps one read-only room per user. Leaving that room, from the chat or with this switch, stops news; the switch turns it on again with a new room. The switch is the last row of the group, below the sound. Novidades items of importance normal are m.notice (no push by the default rule .m.rule.suppress_notices); important items are m.text. The news room is a named room, not a DM (bipe#809, spec chat-list notes).

Per account (bipe-chat/bipe#511): the modes are push rules of the account and live on the server; sound and preview are kept per account on this phone, under the account's Matrix ID. With two accounts on the phone, the footer bipe_notifications_account_footer names the account. Mute of a whole account is chatsMode and groupsMode off.
